name: tantu-lang
description: A typed language with green threads, a type checker and a bytecode VM, in about 6,000 lines of readable Python. Try it in your browser.

paragraphs: A statically-typed, Python-readable language with fibers and channels — compiled to bytecode and run on a hand-built stack VM, implemented in Python 3.12 with zero third-party runtime dependencies.
Try it without installing anything: tantu-play.netlify.app has the full guide and an in-browser playground running this interpreter.
static types with no null (Option/Result), pattern matching, closures, fibers + channels with select, multi-file modules, and user-defined generics. The full test suite and all examples run in CI.
features: Design contract: DESIGN.md (v1.2) is the single source of truth.
Decisions log: DECISIONS.md records anything the design leaves silent.
